ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 70% high-intensity white/cream pixels and 30% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black region concentrated at the median notch and extending along the lower fluke margins. High-intensity white fields cover the majority of the lobes. A mid-intensity yellowish-brown layer is superimposed over the upper-central white areas. Small, discrete black circular spots are scattered within the white fields on both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped median notch with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with frequent high-frequency serrations and jagged peaks, particularly at the lateral tips and notch boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the lateral edges leading to pointed, upward-curving distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Discrete circular black spots (healed scars) on the white ventral surface. Heavy accumulation of textured, high-contrast masses (barnacles) on the far lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of parallel, dark linear marks (rake marks) oriented vertically on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Barnacle colonies on distal tips; vertical rake marks on the right lobe; multiple circular scars across the ventral pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellowish-tan staining across the white areas of the fluke, most likely resulting from diatom accumulation.
